content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the double freeing of memory for extra chunks in the HEP (Handoff Event Protocol) processing when handling SIP messages. The original implementation registered a context free function that was called automatically, leading to memory being freed twice if the message was processed as SIP. This resulted in memory leaks when the message was not a SIP message, as the chunks were not freed properly. The patch resolves this by manually calling the free function after all HEP processing is done, thus preventing both double freeing and memory leaks.
